question: On the aligned real system/microphone capture, does peer-RMS matching change quiet-microphone transcription error relative to the current production fixed-headroom mixer, and is the fixture sufficient to select a production level policy?
scope: diagnostic prototype only; it does not certify G3, G4, G5, or a production mixer policy

system.provenance: real aligned Core Audio Tap/system-audio capture

metrics: word error rate = Levenshtein(reference_tokens, transcript_tokens) / reference_tokens
missing reference words = reference_tokens - LCS(reference_tokens, transcript_tokens)
scoring.model_path: live MOSS vLLM endpoint discovered via GET /v1/models

selection_rule.required_system_reference: a lexical system-lane reference different from the microphone reference
selection_rule.required_limiter_check: candidate limited-output fraction must not exceed production fixed-headroom fraction
selection_rule.if_any_requirement_is_missing: record diagnostic result but select no production normalization, AGC, or fixed-offset policy
